name: calculator
description: Evaluate arithmetic. Input either {"a": number, "b": number, "op": "+|-|*|/|%|^"} or {"expr": "2+3*4"} (operators + - * / % ^, parentheses, standard precedence, sqrt(x) function). Returns {"ok": true, "result": number}.
llm_description: Evaluate arithmetic. Input {a,b,op:'+|-|*|/|%|^'} or {expr:'2+3*4'} (+ - * / % ^, parentheses, standard precedence, sqrt(x)). Returns {ok:true, result:number}.

expr.description: Arithmetic expression such as "2+3*4" or "(1+2)^3". Operators + - * / % ^, parentheses, standard precedence, sqrt(x) function. When present, a/b/op are ignored.
